defects.note: Digits converge into a merged knuckle structure with no coherent palm; fingers fan from an impossible junction.
Extra digit extends to the left, separate from the main finger fan.
Two lit cigarettes float in mid-air, held by nothing and not in the animal's mouth.
A second, detached pair of spectacle frames floats above the head, duplicating the pair on the eyes.
Text in the left-hand book is unreadable squiggle rather than letterforms.
Text in the open book is unreadable squiggle rather than letterforms.
An extra door handle sits high on the rear quarter panel, where there is no door.
The raised claw's digits are webbed and merge at the base; the count and joint structure are incoherent.
The globe's glyphs are nonsense fragments — 'STA', 'VV', 'FI', 'ME' — rather than script.
The hand holding the scissors has elongated fingers that fuse into the blades.
The second hand reads as a shapeless glove; finger separation is lost where it grips the tool.
Printed text on the foreground sheet is gibberish: 'LENTENEBUTJGINE ESIS AE DEUFRMENT'.
